entities.name: Salvador de Sá
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Salvador Correia de Sá e Benevides was a Portuguese admiral and crown administrator. In 1625 he fought the Dutch invasion of Salvador in Brazil and regained Angola and São Tomé Island from the Dutch in 1647. He was the governor of Rio de Janeiro, parts of Southern Brazil and Angola.
